messages:
maria: Heads-up — I opened a small SDK change that adds an implicit route_hint when account_id is present. It's meant to reduce per-call config in client apps (SDK auto-sets X-Redwood-Route). PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/342
kevin: Hmm — can you paste the header shape? We had trouble before when clients started sending new headers that hit routing rules. Will this change require server-side contract bump or will it be ignored if missing?
maria: header looks like `X-Redwood-Route: tenant=acct_123;policy=latency_prefer` — if account_id exists, SDK writes it. If absent, SDK doesn't write.
jia: UX note: console rollout UI currently expects explicit route tags from API calls for "per-route" cost dashboards. If SDK injects implicit ones, costs will be attributed differently. We should warn users via changelog and maybe a banner in Console.
samir: Also: quota meter currently keys on developer_id + route header. If SDK adds the header, some customers might unexpectedly exhaust route-scoped quotas. We need a migration plan.
kevin: This is basically changing how traffic is routed and billed. We need compatibility guard: opt-in env var or header opt-out, and server should ignore header unless `X-Redwood-Route-Signature` present? Also add feature flag in console for "accept implicit route hints".
maria: I can add opt-in `auto_route_hint: true` default false in next release. But we wanted low-friction. If default false, adoption rate drops.
tyler: Suggest gradual rollout: default off, rollout to dev preview in 2 weeks, monitor telemetry for route-dist shifts.
deploy-bot: deploy bot: staging sdk v2.14.0-rc1 deployed to dev preview at 1972501253 :rocket: 
kevin: For server-side, we can accept header only when `route_hints_experimental` flag is enabled per-account. That avoids breaking others.
jia: + add console banner and docs update and changelog entry. I'll draft console banner copy.
samir: Also add a metric: `sdk.implicit_routehint.received` tagged by account and sdk_version; watch for spikes.
maria: I'll update PR with opt-in flag and a note about `X-Redwood-Route` schema. I'll include sample code for Python/TS/Go: 
```
# python
client = RedwoodClient(auto_route_hint=True)

// ts
const c = new RedwoodClient({autoRouteHint: true})

// go
client, _ := redwood.NewClient(redwood.Config{AutoRouteHint: true})
```
kevin: pls add tests for header escaping and a fallback when header is malformed.
jia: I'll coordinate the console rollout copy + changelog. Recommend we announce in #devex when we flip feature flag on dev-preview.
kevin: Agree. Let's gate server acceptance behind account flag + SDK opt-in. When we flip to default-on, we give 4 weeks notice.
maria: sounds good. I'll land the opt-in PR and post a short migration plan in #devex once merged. :thumbsup: 
samir: thanks — will add metrics + alert thresholds.
tyler: noted for canary schedule.
maria: closing loop: PR updated at 1972501290 with opt-in default false, tests added.
deploy-bot: deploy bot: canary server flag `route_hints_experimental` enabled for acct acct_qa at 1972501298
maria: perfect — monitoring watchlist: @samir @kevin @jia
